kinds.a: TENS unit · EMS unit · TENS machine · muscle stimulator
kinds.d: Battery pulse unit with skin pads that stimulates nerves (TENS) to ease pain or muscles (EMS) to contract them.

kinds.a: heat patch · heat wrap · heating pad · ice pack · cold pack · hot-water bottle
kinds.d: Pack, patch or pad applied to the body to warm or cool a sore muscle, joint or injury.

kinds.a: SAD lamp · light box · daylight lamp · energy light
kinds.d: Bright lamp, typically 10,000 lux at a set distance, used daily to lift winter mood or reset sleep timing.
Heavy blanket filled with beads or pellets, giving even pressure to calm and aid sleep.

kinds.a: cervical pillow · contour pillow · neck pillow
kinds.d: Shaped or adjustable pillow made to support the neck, back or joints and ease pain in bed.

brands.d: Family-owned Ulm maker of health and well-being products, from heat pads and TENS units to daylight lamps.
Kyoto electronics group whose healthcare arm sells home monitors and TENS units.
Swiss electrostimulation brand of the DJO group, with over 30 years in physiotherapy, pain and sports training.
French start-up making app-connected electrostimulation devices.
Maker of the Elle TENS labour TENS machine with a boost button for contractions.
Cambridge light-therapy brand that made the first wake-up light in 1992.
Eindhoven health-technology company whose personal-care range includes energy lights and wake-up lights.
Air-activated iron-powder heat-wrap brand launched by Procter & Gamble, now owned by Angelini.
UK maker of handmade weighted blankets registered as Class I medical devices.
Weighted blanket brand launched through a 2017 Kickstarter campaign.
London sleep brand selling mattresses, bedding and the Orbit weighted blanket.
Maker of viscoelastic-foam mattresses and pillows, including the TEMPUR-Neck pillow.
Maker of adjustable water-base pillows sold for neck pain.

notes: Shelf 'Pain relief & therapy devices' rebuilt as 5 tier kinds (was 4). Heat patch broadened to Heat & cold pack with types (self-heating patch, electric heat pad, gel pack, instant cold pack, hot-water bottle, wheat bag). Light-therapy lamp added (Lumie, Philips, Beurer). TENS: cut Beurer skew from 5 to 2 models (dropped EM29, EM38, EM44); added Omron PM500, Compex SP 8.0, Bluetens Classic 2/Duo Sport 2. Elvie could not be confirmed as a labour-TENS maker (search found none), so labour TENS is covered by Elle TENS 2 instead. Weighted blanket: dropped Sensory Direct Snuggly Tactile (one-brand skew), added Gravity Blanket and Simba Orbit; old retailer source replaced with Wikipedia. Orthopaedic pillow keeps its old Mediflow source; added TEMPUR-Neck. No independent test winners (Which?/CHOICE/Consumer Reports) could be retrieved for these kinds, so none are cited. No traditions apply. Wiki/wikidata tools failed (lock-file error), so all sources were retrieved with web_fetch.
